title: Caramelised onion and chilli ramen with soy eggs

source.title: Meera Sodha's caramelised onion and chilli ramen

ingredients.name: Rapeseed oil
ingredients.amount: 5 tbsp, plus a little for the noodles

ingredients.name: Cooking sake
ingredients.amount: 2 tbsp, or rice wine or dry sherry

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.amount: 6 medium, for the soy eggs, optional

instructions: Soy eggs, the night before: mix 100ml soy sauce, the vinegar, sugar and 150ml cold water in a jar. Lower the eggs into a pan of boiling water and cook for exactly 7 minutes, then cool in iced water for 10 minutes. Peel, drop into the soy mix, cover with kitchen paper to keep them under and leave in the fridge overnight.
Finely slice the onions, garlic and chilli. Cut the choi sum into 6cm pieces.

Warm the oil in a large heavy pan over a medium heat. Add the onions, garlic and salt and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, until translucent. Turn the heat to its lowest and cook for 30 minutes more, stirring every 5 minutes, until the onions caramelise and break down.
Add the chilli and stock and bring to the boil. Reduce to a simmer, stir in the sake, soy and miso, and check the seasoning.
Cook the noodles as the packet says, refresh in cold water and stir in a little oil. Bring the broth back to the boil, add the choi sum and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until tender.
Divide the noodles between four bowls, ladle over the broth and greens, top with halved soy eggs and chilli oil.
